title: A Yearbook for the Group Chat
author: Gideon Hartwell
blurb: Rosalind Kavanagh, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. But when the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
